changes: POST /api/v1/aiAgents/admin/review-replay-capture — api path removed without deprecation

declaredAdvisories.reason: POST /api/v1/aiAgents/admin/review-replay-capture and its AiAgentReviewReplayCapture request and response types are removed together with the ai-review-replay-capture feature flag. The endpoint was org-admin only and refused callers unless that flag was on, and the flag was off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted. Callers now get a 404.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The internal AI review classifier scoreboard repl script (captureReviewScoreboardFixtureFromApi) was the only client, and it is removed in the same change. An older checkout of that script gets a 404 during a rolling update, which is safe because it is an offline eval tool, not part of the product.
